rationale: The clinical notes from Desert Springs Emergency Dental record heavy drinking, a smell of alcohol, unsteadiness on arrival, a memory gap from about 10 pm to 9 am, and the customer's belief that he removed the tooth himself during the night. The loss therefore arose while the customer was impaired by alcohol, which the general exclusion in section 9 of the policy wording ("Losses while you are breaking the law or impaired by alcohol or drugs") removes, so the emergency dental claim under section 7 is not payable. The policy has no add-ons that change this exclusion, and the claim history is clean; the payout is $0 under sections 9 and 10 of the wording and manual section 6.
